title: Admirable Campaign
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Admirable Campaign", at revision 1380629093, opens: "The Admirable Campaign was a military expedition conducted by the United Provinces of New Granada and allied venezuelan republican forces against spanish royalist control in western and central Venezuela between 14 of May and 6 of August 1813, during the Spanish American wars of Independence, Colombian war of Independence and Venezuelan war of Independence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q8940, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of the Venezuelan War of Independence (1813)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
